name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Avatar-Cell
description: Table cell displaying a user or entity avatar with optional name label. Use to identify people, bots, or organizations in table rows.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Photo-Cell
description: Table cell displaying a thumbnail photo or image. Use for product images, document previews, or media in table rows.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Basic-Icon-Cell
description: Table cell displaying a single icon representing the row's type or status. Use for file-type icons, category icons, or status icons in table rows.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Dock-Icon-Cell
description: Table cell displaying a stylized dock/app icon. Use to represent application modules, workspaces, or brand items in table rows.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Text-Cell
description: Table cell for primary and secondary text content. Supports single-line labels, two-line text stacks, and truncation for long values.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Progress-Cell
description: Table cell containing a progress bar to visualize task completion, usage, or any percentage value inline in a table row.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Badge-Cell
description: Small visual indicator used to highlight status, tags, or notification counts.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Tag-Cell
description: Table cell displaying one or more Tag labels. Use to show categories, technologies, or attributes associated with a record.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Trend-Cell
description: Table cell displaying a trend indicator (up/down arrow with percentage) for period-over-period metric changes. Use in analytics and reporting tables.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Control-Cell
description: Table cell containing an interactive form control (Toggle, Checkbox, or Select). Use for inline boolean settings or status switches in table rows.

variants.d: Selection control allowing users to select one or multiple options from a list.
Interactive element used to trigger single actions or events.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Actions-Cell
description: Table cell containing row-level action buttons (Edit, Delete, View, More). Always the rightmost column. Use for primary record operations.

variants.d: Interactive element used to trigger single actions or events.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Group-Avatar-Cell
description: Visual representation of a user, team, or entity.

name: Primitives/Table/Cell/Editabled-Cell
description: Navigation element used to switch between different views or data sets.
